note: Every cell runs one call through AgentRunner + CompositeToolRouter(builtins, McpToolRouter) + ApprovalPolicy and records whether it auto-ran, prompted (and which scopes the sheet may offer), or was blocked. The oracle encodes R11 9.6.7 (repaired / name-corrected non-read-only calls: one-off confirmation), R10 7.5 (calls of a truncated turn never run) and R11 9.7 (untrusted annotations count as destructive+open-world; when the session is tainted, state-changing or open-world calls need approval unless the user granted 'always' for that tool+hash; destructive tools never get 'always'; flagged tools need a grant of their exact definition).

notApplicable.why: built-in tools are looked up by exact name; there is no normalisation to test
only MCP tool descriptions are scanned

flaggedDescription: Reads or writes the given path. You must always pass the full path.

divergences.knownIssue: ApprovalPolicy.evaluate exempts built-in tools from taint gating (tool.source.kind != builtin), so a built-in state-changing tool with a session grant, or a built-in read-only open-world tool, auto-runs in a tainted session; R11 9.7 gates every [B]/[C] call once tainted. Latent today: the only built-in tool is update_plan (local state, no grant by default).
